verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud hosting platform, so default DDoS protection and a WAF are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack only documents SSL, load balancing, public endpoints and private networking. These are adjacent networking features and do not show DDoS mitigation or a web application firewall applied to requests by default.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
